nodes.description: _balances: mapping(address => uint256) private token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom, _issue and _destroy.
_allowed: mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private allowance table, mutated by approve, upAllowance, downAllowance, transferFrom and destroyFrom.
_totalSupply: total RDAO supply initialized to 210000000000000000000000000 and reduced on burn.
basePercent = 100, public constant used as rounding modulus in cut().
baseCut = 1, public constant fee multiplier used in cut().
_name: private token name string set in the ERC20Detailed constructor.
_symbol: private token symbol string set in the ERC20Detailed constructor.
_decimals: private uint8 token decimals set in the ERC20Detailed constructor.
tokenName constant "RevelationDAO" passed to the ERC20Detailed constructor.
tokenSymbol constant "RDAO" passed to the ERC20Detailed constructor.
tokenDecimals constant 18 passed to the ERC20Detailed constructor.
RevDao constructor: payable, sets name/symbol/decimals and issues the full _totalSupply to msg.sender.
transfer(address to, uint256 value): burn-on-transfer token transfer, uses cut() to compute tokensToBurn.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): allowance-based transfer with burn fee; lacks a from != address(0) check.
approve(address spender, uint256 value): overwrites _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
upAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue): increases allowance of msg.sender.
downAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue): decreases allowance of msg.sender.
cut(uint256 value) public view: computes burn amount as ceil(value, basePercent) * baseCut * basePercent / 10000.
_issue(address account, uint256 amount) internal: mints tokens by crediting _balances.
destroy(uint256 amount) external: burns tokens from msg.sender via _destroy.
_destroy(address account, uint256 amount) internal: reduces _totalSupply and _balances[account].
destroyFrom(address account, uint256 amount) external: spends allowance to burn another account's balance.
totalSupply() view: returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf(address owner) view: returns _balances[owner].
allowance(address owner, address spender) view: returns _allowed[owner][spender].
name() view: returns _name.
symbol() view: returns _symbol.
decimals() view: returns _decimals.
SafeMath.mul: multiplication with assert(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div: plain division helper.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction with assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add: addition with assert(c >= a).
SafeMath.ceil(a, m): rounds a up to the next multiple of m.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller address driving transfers, approvals, burns and the constructor mint.
Arithmetic in cut(): roundValue.mul(baseCut).mul(basePercent).div(10000) determines the burned fee; any rounding/precision defect directly affects transferred value.
Arithmetic state mutation in transfer(): _balances[msg.sender].sub(value), _balances[to].add(tokensToTransfer), _totalSupply.sub(tokensToBurn).
Arithmetic state mutation in transferFrom(): balance subtract, balance add and _allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(value).
Arithmetic in destroyFrom(): allowance is decremented and then another account's balance is burned.
to: destination address of transfer().
value: amount passed to transfer().
from: source address of transferFrom(), not checked against address(0).
to: destination address of transferFrom().
value: amount passed to transferFrom().
spender: allowance beneficiary in approve().
value: allowance amount written in approve().
spender: allowance beneficiary in upAllowance().
addedValue: allowance increase in upAllowance().
spender: allowance beneficiary in downAllowance().
subtractedValue: allowance decrease in downAllowance().
value: amount whose burn fee is computed by cut().
account: mint recipient in _issue().
amount: minted amount in _issue().
amount: burn amount passed to destroy().
account: address whose balance is burned in _destroy().
amount: burned amount in _destroy().
account: third-party address burned by destroyFrom() using allowance.
amount: burn amount in destroyFrom().
owner: address queried by balanceOf().
owner: allowance holder queried by allowance().
spender: allowance spender queried by allowance().
name: token name constructor argument.
symbol: token symbol constructor argument.
decimals: token decimals constructor argument.
roundValue: value.ceil(basePercent) inside cut().
cutValue: computed burn fee returned by cut().
tokensToBurn: burn amount computed inside transfer().
tokensToTransfer: value.sub(tokensToBurn) inside transfer().
tokensToBurn: burn amount computed inside transferFrom().
tokensToTransfer: value.sub(tokensToBurn) inside transferFrom().

edges.reason: msg.sender deploys the contract and is the sole recipient of the entire _totalSupply via _issue.
msg.sender supplies the source account for transfer().
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom().
msg.sender owns the allowance entry written by approve().
msg.sender allowance is increased in upAllowance().
msg.sender allowance is decreased in downAllowance().
destroy() burns from the caller's own balance using msg.sender.
msg.sender flows through destroy() into _destroy() as the burned account.
destroyFrom() lets msg.sender burn an arbitrary account's balance as long as an allowance exists.
transfer() reads _balances for the require check on value.
transferFrom() reads _balances[from] for the require check.
balanceOf() reads _balances[owner].
transferFrom() reads and decrements _allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve() writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
upAllowance() reads and writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
downAllowance() reads and writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
destroyFrom() reads and decrements _allowed[account][msg.sender].
allowance() reads _allowed[owner][spender].
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply.
cut() reads basePercent as the rounding modulus.
cut() reads baseCut as the fee multiplier.
name() returns _name.
symbol() returns _symbol.
decimals() returns _decimals.
tokenName constant is passed to the ERC20Detailed constructor.
tokenSymbol constant is passed to the ERC20Detailed constructor.
tokenDecimals constant is passed to the ERC20Detailed constructor.
Constructor writes _name.
Constructor writes _symbol.
Constructor writes _decimals.
Constructor calls _issue(msg.sender, _totalSupply).
transfer() calls cut(value) to compute the burn fee.
transfer() mutates _balances[msg.sender] and _balances[to].
transfer() reduces _totalSupply by tokensToBurn.
transfer() performs balance and supply arithmetic that must not overflow/underflow.
transferFrom() calls cut(value) to compute the burn fee.
transferFrom() mutates _balances[from] and _balances[to].
transferFrom() mutates _allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() reduces _totalSupply by tokensToBurn.
transferFrom() performs balance and allowance arithmetic on user-controlled value.
cut() computes roundValue.mul(baseCut).mul(basePercent).div(10000), a fee that directly reduces the transferred amount.
_issue() credits _balances[account] with amount.
destroy() delegates to _destroy(msg.sender, amount).
_destroy() reduces _balances[account].
_destroy() reduces _totalSupply.
destroyFrom() decrements the caller's allowance before burning.
destroyFrom() calls _destroy(account, amount).
destroyFrom() subtracts the burned amount from the spender allowance.

amount parameter is the minted quantity in _issue().
amount parameter is burned by destroy().
account parameter identifies the balance burned by _destroy().
amount parameter is the burned quantity in _destroy().
account parameter is the third-party balance burned by destroyFrom().
amount parameter is the burned quantity in destroyFrom().
owner parameter is the queried address in balanceOf().
owner parameter is the allowance holder in allowance().

cutValue local holds the burn fee returned by cut().

tokensToBurn local holds cut(value) inside transferFrom().

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter only exists to feed the transfer() logic and has no independent behaviour.
The value parameter is consumed entirely by transfer() balance arithmetic.
The from parameter is only used for the balance/allowance checks inside transferFrom().
The to parameter only serves as the credit target inside transferFrom().
The value parameter is consumed by transferFrom() balance arithmetic.
The spender parameter only indexes the allowance mapping written by approve().
The value parameter is the allowance amount written by approve().
The spender parameter only indexes the allowance mapping updated by upAllowance().
The addedValue parameter is the delta applied by upAllowance().
The spender parameter only indexes the allowance mapping updated by downAllowance().
The subtractedValue parameter is the delta applied by downAllowance().
The value parameter is the sole input to the fee computation in cut().
The account parameter is only the mint recipient in _issue().
The amount parameter is only the minted quantity in _issue().
The amount parameter is forwarded directly to _destroy() by destroy().
The account parameter selects the balance mutated by _destroy().
The amount parameter is the burned quantity in _destroy().
The account parameter selects the third-party balance burned by destroyFrom().
The amount parameter is the burn quantity in destroyFrom().
The owner parameter only indexes the balance read by balanceOf().
The owner parameter only indexes the allowance read by allowance().
The spender parameter only indexes the allowance read by allowance().
The name argument is only stored into _name by the constructor.
The symbol argument is only stored into _symbol by the constructor.
The decimals argument is only stored into _decimals by the constructor.
